name: forge-floor-dashboard
description: Backend-agnostic operations dashboard for AI agents and autonomous workflows.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:e2e-rest && npm run build:e2e-runtime && npm run build:e2e-ann && playwright test
scripts.test:a11y: vitest run src/test/a11y.test.tsx && npm run test:e2e -- e2e/a11y.spec.ts
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && npm run build:e2e-rest && npm run build:e2e-ann && playwright test e2e/visual.spec.ts
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run build && npm run build:e2e-rest && npm run build:e2e-ann && playwright test e2e/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:visual:ci-image: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.56.1-noble npx playwright test e2e/visual.spec.ts
scripts.test:visual:ci-image:update: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e CI=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.56.1-noble npx playwright test e2e/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots
